STIR YOUR IMAGINATION EVENTS

Permanent photo setup: open adding-photos.html. Photographs are loaded from project files listed in gallery-data.js, not temporary browser selections.

For later Squarespace integration, host the complete dist folder at a public HTTPS address. Private demo links require sign-in. On an unpublished Squarespace page, use an iframe Code block pointing to that public gallery URL. Adjust iframe height to fit all transformations on desktop and phone. No changes have been made to your live Squarespace website.
